expected_sha256 = SHA-256 of the canonical (LF) committed bytes, verified on the laptop against the preserved copies (manifests) and the committed git blobs (engineering candidate, prelaunch report). A file matches if its raw bytes or its CRLF->LF-normalised bytes hash to this value; any other difference BLOCKS and must be resolved, never bypassed.

Every exclusion reason present in each manifest is declared (acquisition: missing_game_file, not_selected; extension: + selected_in_parent_acquisition_queue; evaluation: missing_game_file, not_selected, replaced_before_freeze_...). An undeclared reason turns the split UNKNOWN.

status=unresolved sources have no authoritative task identities. By default their scope splits become UNKNOWN (fail closed: empty pools). 'exposure --allow-provisional' keeps tasks screenable for PREPARATION ONLY; every output is then marked provisional and roster_approval_blockers is non-empty. Resolve them (replace with a real source and remove 'status') before any scientific roster approval.
Policies are distinct and named. A policy naming a role with no evidence is reported (roles_without_any_evidence) and blocks roster approval; it is never silently treated as 'nothing to exclude'.

known_template_screened needs a template_list source with role known_template_match. The university-reported 79 -> 77 is reproduced exactly (per family) by the single goal template pick_heat_then_place_in_recep|Potato|None|GarbageCan; that is a reconstruction from counts, NOT an authoritative source. Add it only once the university audit's own list is confirmed, e.g. {"id": "university-audit-known-templates", "kind": "template_list", "role": "known_template_match", "scope_splits": ["valid_unseen"], "template_definition": "goal_template", "templates": [...], "provenance": "<audit file and line>"}.
